claim_text: New York Senate bill S9960, the Trafficking Survivor Recovery and Accountability Act sponsored by Sen. Zellnor Myrie, was introduced on April 17, 2026 and advanced by the Senate Codes Committee on May 4, 2026 after Epstein survivors testified.

CNN reported on February 25, 2026 that 2019 texts show U.S. Virgin Islands Gov. Albert Bryan Jr. telling Epstein he had asked the territory's environmental commissioner to pause enforcement against construction on Epstein's islands, and writing 'We got u'; Bryan denies wrongdoing.

An October 2023 FBI interview of former U.S. Virgin Islands Attorney General Denise George, released by DOJ on January 30, 2026, records her account that Gov. Bryan pressed her in 2019 to grant Epstein a waiver from sex-offender travel-notice rules and later questioned her Epstein investigation.
